## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: `plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md` updated at the DD partitioning step — explicit guard: "Items under `## Closure Checks` are excluded from the DD partition. Only done definitions and success criteria from `## Done Definitions` / `## Success Criteria` sections are assigned to tasks."
- DD2: Test (behavioral): a story ticket with 3 done definitions and 2 Closure Checks items produces tasks whose Story DD Coverage sections reference only the 3 done definitions — no Closure Checks items appear in any task's coverage section
- DD3: Note added inline in the implementation-plan SKILL.md partition step explaining why: "Closure Checks are verified at story/epic closure by the completion-verifier agent; they are not implementation targets."

## File Impact
| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md` | Modify — add Closure Checks exclusion guard at line ~752 (DD partitioning step) |

## Implementation Steps

### 1. Locate the DD partitioning paragraph (line ~752 in SKILL.md)

The paragraph currently reads:

```
Before creating each task, partition the story's done definitions across all tasks so every DD appears in exactly one task's Story DD Coverage section. Every story DD must be owned by at least one task.
```

### 2. Replace the paragraph with the updated version that includes the Closure Checks exclusion guard and explanatory note

Replace the single paragraph with the following expanded block:

```
Before creating each task, partition the story's done definitions across all tasks so every DD appears in exactly one task's Story DD Coverage section. Every story DD must be owned by at least one task.

**Closure Checks exclusion**: Before partitioning, identify any items listed under a `## Closure Checks` section in the story description — these items are EXCLUDED from the DD partition and must NOT be assigned to any task's Story DD Coverage section. Closure Checks are verified at story/epic closure by the completion-verifier agent; they are end-state intent checks, not implementation work items. Only items under `## Done Definitions` (or `## Success Criteria`) are eligible for partitioning into tasks.

> **Example**: A story with DD1, DD2, DD3 under `## Done Definitions` and CC1, CC2 under `## Closure Checks` produces tasks whose Story DD Coverage sections list only DD1, DD2, DD3. CC1 and CC2 never appear in any task's coverage section.
```

### 3. Verify the edit

Run a grep to confirm the exclusion guard text is present and no Closure Checks reference leaks into the DD partition instruction itself:

```bash
grep -n "Closure Checks exclusion" plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
grep -n "completion-verifier agent" plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] SKILL.md contains the Closure Checks exclusion guard at the DD partitioning step (exit 0)
  Verify: grep -q "Closure Checks exclusion" plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md contains the explanatory note referencing the completion-verifier agent (exit 0)
  Verify: grep -q "completion-verifier agent" plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
- [ ] No Closure Checks item text appears in any task's Story DD Coverage section in the worked example (manual review of the added example block)
data.title: Update implementation-plan SKILL.md DD partitioning step to exclude Closure Checks items
